build_note: Installed from the pinned pure-Python py3-none-any wheel by hash; the image checks that the wheel's DNS/ package is byte-identical to the pinned sdist and that DNS/Lib.py, DNS/Base.py, DNS/__init__.py and the LICENSE match recorded SHA-256 values. No runtime dependencies.
dependencies_note: atheris 3.1.0 is the in-process fuzz bridge only; py3dns has no runtime dependencies.
parser_family: py3dns / PyDNS (DNS/Lib.py Munpacker classes and DnsResult.storeM; Python 3 port of Guido van Rossum's pydns)
coverage: Python line tracing of the installed py3dns DNS package during valid-control replay; Atheris import instrumentation for the byte-input bridge
scope: One RFC 1035 DNS message from local bytes via DNS.Lib.DnsResult over DNS.Lib.MunpackerText: header flags (3-bit z from Hunpacker.getHeader) and the header's four counts, questions, and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names; valid response and query controls only. MunpackerText returns A as dotted text and AAAA via inet_ntop of the 16 decoded bytes; the harness only joins the MX (preference, exchange) tuple and adds trailing dots. Importing the DNS package runs Base._DiscoverNameServers(), which reads /etc/resolv.conf as a local file; no socket is created and no query is sent.
